result.description: Cloud communications platform with APIs for SMS, voice, WhatsApp, email, verify and more.
result.auth_detail: HTTP Basic with API Key SID/secret (preferred) or Account SID/Auth Token. Each end user can create own API key. OAuth2 (Client Credentials account-level; Authorization Code for org-level apps) also exists, plus legacy Connect apps; OAuth docs not fully verified.
result.access_detail: Free trial signup without credit card (email + phone verification). Trial API keys work, but only to 5 verified recipients, sign-up country only, 30-day expiry. Upgrade removes verified-recipient limit. Per-account API keys that users create themselves, so no app review/ISV gate for Basic/API-key auth. No paid plan needed for API access. Unverified: whether OAuth Authorization Code apps need Twilio review.
result.api_notes: REST over HTTPS (api.twilio.com/2010-04-01 plus many product subdomains) covering messaging, voice, verify, conversations, lookups, usage, etc. SDKs in many languages. Whole API exposed via OpenAPI.

evidence.quote: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, use HTTP Basic authentication.
API keys are the preferred way to authenticate with Twilio's REST APIs.
You can sign up for a Twilio free trial account without a credit card.
You can send messages and make calls only to verified phone numbers.
The Twilio APIs are organized around REST.
This implementation allows you to expose Twilio's APIs to AI assistants and other tools that support the MCP protocol.
